answer.explanation: The live Thumbnailer configuration sets ReservedConcurrentExecutions to 1, but the SAM template (intended state) declares no reserved concurrency for ThumbnailerFunction. The AWS/Lambda Throttles metric for this function shows about 100 throttles across the window (1 to 18 per minute). The other three functions match the template on memory, timeout, environment variables and concurrency. The Thumbnailer logs show no error or exception lines, so the throttling is the symptom of the concurrency cap rather than a code or IAM failure. The config change was applied on 2026-10-19, before the window, and it is the likely cause.
